description:
GPSControl Fleet connects your existing GPSControl tracking account to ChatGPT, so you can ask about your vehicles instead of opening the tracking site and building a report.

Ask where a vehicle is and get its street address, status and last report time. Ask what it did last week and get its trips, stops, working hours and fuel. Ask what went wrong and get speeding, geofence, temperature and connection alerts, traffic penalties and maintenance that is coming due. Any of the platform's 49 reports can be run by name and returned as its own table.

It reads only. There is no tool that can move, rename or delete anything, send a command to a vehicle, or change a setting. Answers are scoped to the vehicles your own account already sees, in your account's units and language, and you sign in on GPSControl's own page so ChatGPT never sees your password.

defaultPrompt: Which of my vehicles are moving right now?
How much fuel did my fleet use last week?
What alerts fired on my fleet yesterday?
